threads.title: Where we've been, and the future

posts.author: RiotShielder
posts.message:
A few weeks ago, the hard drive on our server failed, our provider refused to replace it. This led to our downtime and the lost of all data we had prior, as all backups had been kept on that drive at the time.

So this means (another) fresh start, hopefully a better one. Currently I'm working on getting the server and forums back into working shape. The server is already up and running, however things will reset/change between now and the completed server, so don't be shocked if the map is suddenly reset, all your crystals are gone, etc. We're simply working on making the server better. That being said, I can guarantee that the map will be reset before our full launch, until then feel free to build as your heart desires.

As for the future of the server, I'm going to have to redo everything, all progress I had made prior was lost. This isn't completely bad though, as we've got a guy making a spawn city for us, soon we'll be in full drive again to make this server possible.

If you're not aware, The Storm is a survival/economy server with RPG elements, which is just a fancy way of saying you'll be able to play survival with a ton of awesome features such as quests, skills, and a bunch more.

The server is currently running 1.7.10/1.8, you can join with either version, but please be aware no 1.8 blocks/features work on the server currently, and it is currently unknown if/when they will work.

That concludes this post. More announcements will track progress as the server and forums take shape.

posts.author: RiotShielder
posts.message:
Introducing Quests

A few of you have likely noticed the NPC's standing around spawn, today we're releasing the quest system! We currently only have 2 relatively short quests, which are rather easy and meant to introduce you into how questing will work on The Storm.

Why should I complete quests?

​The biggest benefit of questing is the unique things you can earn from them, including specially enchanted items, titles, and perks. Along with all that, you can earn crystals (fairly) easily. Some quests you can complete only once, while others you can repeat every day.

Will more quests be added?

As said, we currently only have a two quests, both aren't that hard to complete. We're planning on creating 10-20 quests in the next 2 weeks, with at least 2 being 'epic' quests -- quests that have 10+ stages (Most have 2-5)

After we get these quests completed, we will start focusing on the perks system.

Over the past couple of weeks, I've been working on fixing various server bugs, working on the new server spawn, and creating new quests. Today, I added a new feature to the server -- the Mob Arena

The Mob Arena is a wave-based arena, in which you clear 72 waves of mobs with a kit that you choose. Currently the only reward is a small amount of crystals, however it will be increased in the future. Later on, we will also add quests for the Mob Arena that you can complete for titles, quest points, and more.

You can join the Mob Arena with /ma j

Please note that the Mob Arena isn't completely finished yet, we still need to tweak the waves and classes a bit, and as such, the rewards won't be very large. Once it is completed, you will receive a moderate amount of crystals after boss waves.

posts.author: RiotShielder
posts.message:
Hey everyone.

I'm working on some new features for the existing perks, as well as some for all players.

Backpacks

The first thing that we are looking to add are backpacks. You'll be able to use the /backpack command, and with it you'll have a double-chest sized inventory to store items, however these will still drop on death. This may be added as part of a new perk, or something else.

Player-created Arenas

We'll soon be adding in a system so that player-created arenas (It can be a mob or PvP arena) will be able to be used for server usage. It'll likely work so that you build a nice-looking arena, and you'll get paid a fairly nice sum of crystals.

LiveMap markers

Eventually we will be adding markers to the LiveMap, so that we can label items at spawn, and in the other worlds. In the future, you may be able to label your own creations for easy finding on the LiveMap (Though this may attract griefers if you don't protect your land before marking it)

A new perk

Lastly, we are looking into adding a 5th perk to the game, we haven't worked out the details yet, however it'll likely come after the existing 4 are completed.

Hopefully everyone is enjoying the server! As always if you have a suggestion for the server, feel free to post it here on the forums.

Hello and welcome to The Storm.

Here, I will be describing just a bit about how the server works.

First, crystals. Crystals are the currency used in ‘The Storm’. You can currently gain them by doing quests, which I will get to later, The mob arena, and Trading/Buying/Selling with other players on the server.

One quick thing about the spawn. The spawn area is a 1000x1000 space in which the spawn point is held at 0,0. You will notice you can't break anything and can't pvp in that area. You must go out of the 1000x1000 area to start building and or pvping. Note: thats aprx 500 blocks in any direction from spawn.

Click on the tabs to go more detain into the topics!

Spoiler: Detail: Quests

Quests: First, you must be a commoner to do these. As you are on the forums you must be a commoner. If you are not a commoner yet, then restart your minecraft and you will be a commoner!

Quests are lazy people asking you to do things. Basically people holding a sign, “Please be my slave for money.”

How to tell: You can tell if a person is asking for a quest if there are enchanting symbols around their body.

To start a quest: Right click their body and they will reply with a short summary of their quest and ask you if you would take the quest or not. Simply answer in chat ‘Yes’ or ‘No’. Obviously if you state ‘yes’ they continue with the quest. If you reply ‘no’ they just shut up and you can move on. :D

These quest workers will ask you to do such tasks and at the end of everything give you a reward.

You can only have 1 quest at a time so be careful which one you choose!

Do ./quests for in-depth commands for the quests

Spoiler: Detail: Perks

Perks: These perks are classes you can become throughout the game. There are people at the spawn area that will ‘train’ you how to become these classes by giving them crystals.

After you get your perks: After you train and get the perk you can use the command

./setprefix [Perk]. An example of this would be ./setprefix commoner, ./setprefix Mechanic etc.

These perks will give you the power to gain specific abilities that come with that specific perk. The pros of having more perks are the fact that it makes regular survival more interesting with new powers and abilities. Play around with them!

You can figure out more things about perks and their ability at a mmo wiki.

Note: You can be multiple classes/ Obtain multiple perks at once. Although you can only have One prefix at once.

Spoiler: Perks: Power Levels

Power Levels: These power levels are obtained by doing an act of some sort. For example, you would gain mining levels when you mine. You can get archery levels when you shoot the bow and hit a mob/player. etc.

These levels max out at 250 per skill. ex. If you have 250 mining levels, you wont get more levels from mining.

Currently, the max total levels can’t exceed 1500 but soon will change or can be bought to raise the max level.

You can see how the levels will benefit you by using the command ./[Skill] Ex. ./mining ./acrobatic etc.

Spoiler: Detail: Different Worlds

Different Worlds: There is the Regular World, The Nether, The End, and The Sky Lands.

You can access the sky lands by standing on the beacon light at spawn. The sky lands are the regular world buy on small floating islands. As of now, if you fall off, you lose everything as you fall into the void. Be careful.

The end and the nether are the same as in vanilla minecraft. You must go into a nether portal or an end portal.

You can check the worlds by going on to the Live map.

Spoiler: Detail: Mob Arena

MobArena: The mob arena has 8 different classes. Currently 72 levels. every level with the unit digit of 5, there is a swarm. Aka, a stampede of 1hp mobs harassing you. Every 10 levels, these is a boss. You get crystal prizes as soon as the boss is on the field. Prizes of crystals start on level 30.

The current classes are

picture: http://imgur.com/WrFmPm7

The brief summary of the classes:

Madman: OverPowered diamond axe, with strength and speed pots. Amazing for hoards and bosses. The armour is terrible.

Healer: Decent armour with 2 stacks of health splash potions. Terrible sword but amazing support class.

Chemist: Get tons of potions from poison to instant damage. Armour and sword are alright.

WolfMaster: Comes with wolves. Full leather armour and the sword is weak. The dogs will almost protect you from anything and will be extremely helpful in boss fights.

Guardian: fire sword, decent armour. Comes with strenght and health pots. It can withstand hits and hit hard.

Knight: Good sharp III diamond sword and good armour. Standard kit.

Tank: Can withstand many hits. It has a good knockback and fire aspect sword that can give you recovery. Can withstand through crowds and help people in need.

Archer: Power V flame bow. Can one shot almost all mobs with 15 health or lower. It also has 3 dogs to help you kill in short distance fights when you are attacked from behind. If you are not aware of your surroundings, a creeper can OHKO you as well. Weak defence, strong power.

Spoiler: Detail: Creating Towns and Shops

Creating towns and shops: You can buy towns and shops in the server. To buy a shop, you must have the perk [ShopKeeper]. To go more elaborate into towns, use the command ./town or ./town ?. To get started on a town, it costs 2500 for the first chunk. 30 crystals on the next few chunks. The rent is 100 crystals per day.

What happens when you can't pay the rent? Well, you just dont get to own that town and you are at spot one again.

What are the pros of making a town. The main reason is that no one can break your blocks except for the people you allow in your town. This means that everything in your town is protected. You can also change the settings and set pvp off or some other things.

Well once again, have fun on the server. Check the rules on the forums and do ./rules in game. Some rules may not be stating in the ./rules section but use common sense. Hacking, and being rude is not acceptable.

Ill continue and update this as the days go on and riot decided to make some updates.

Werewolf

In its simplest form Werewolf is played by two teams: the Werewolves, whose members know each other's identity, and the Civilians, who at first know only the number of wolves in the game. Games require a moderator who does not participate as a player.

There are two phases: "night," when the Werewolves may eliminate a player from the game, and "day," during which players vote to "lynch" a suspect. These phases follow each other continuously until all Werewolves have been eliminated or the Werewolves outnumber the Civilians.

Some players may be given a role with a special ability. These players are considered the leaders of either clan. To activate one’s ability, you must message the Moderator that is hosting the game outside of the playing field including details of what you will do. There will be no revealing of anyones roles during the game unless it is by the Moderator. Common examples include:

The Spy: a Civilian or Werewolf who may "investigate" one player every two nights, learning that player's role from the moderator.

The Doctor: a Civilian who may protect a single player from being killed by Wolves each night.

The Conspiracist: a Civilian who may once kill any other player during the night.

The Bystander: a Civilian or Werewolf who may cancel the effect of another player’s ability each night.

The Shark: a Werewolf who may kill a Civilian every night.

Gameplay

This game is based on talking during the day, making accusations, befriending and rivaling others by only utilizing information that is presented within the game. Please keep in mind this is only a game, and that anything presented in said game should not be taken personally. There should be an odd number of players when the game is hosted, but it can accommodate and amount of players. The game will start on day, after all players have been assigned their roles. The game will begin with accusations being made, and end with a climactic lynching. Please don’t be afraid to quote very old posts from the forum, as it is only part of the game. Use the posts as evidence, and quote them to signify who and what you’re talking about.

Night

All players become inactive. The moderator then instructs all members of the Werewolves to begin chatting in their private message group. They pick a "victim" by voting and talking within their own chat with the Moderator. Once all abilities have been used by both Civilians and Werewolves, and all the votes are tallied, day will resume.

A similar process occurs for other roles with nightly actions. In the case of The Spy, the moderator will respond to The Spy in a private message giving the answer to his ability.

No talking will be permitted by Civilians or Werewolves during the nighttime period within the main forum. This also pertains to there being NO talking of the game outside of the forum. Any evidence or reports of this will have you immediately removed from the game.

Day

The moderator instructs players to once again become active and announces who had been killed the previous night. The role of the murdered player will be revealed to all and commonly supplied with a story to keep the players happy. Dead players may not attempt to influence the game in any way. The same goes for any players that are not signed up with the game.

Discussion ensues again. At any point a player may accuse someone of being a Werewolf and prompt others to vote to lynch him. If over half of the players do so, or however many the majority is, the accused person is eliminated, his role is revealed, and night begins. Otherwise, the phase continues until a lynching occurs. Because players have more freedom to deliberate, days tend to be longer than nights. Please don’t try to rush the game, and think out all decisions before you enact upon them, or you could end up dead next.

This world will reset every so often, most likely between 2-3 weeks, so please be sure to not build anything of importance there. The mining world has a warp right next to the Skylands. Also special rules apply to the mining world, namely griefing is allowed, everything is fair game with the exception of locked chests.

We are still expanding spawn, creating quests, and updating the wiki. For now the focus is on refining and documenting the features added over the last few weeks.

Hey everyone!

I've been doing some more minor tweaks recently, nothing on it's own deserves an announcement so I'll just add it all up into this single one, I'll also be covering what I see for the future of The Storm.

Firstly, a lot of various changes. Lots of stuff most people won't notice too, but it doesn't matter.

New 1.8 blocks now lockable

After tonights restart, all 1.8 items should be lockable. This means all of the new doors, gates, and iron trapdoors. Also we will be tweaking the lock limits soon. Currently everyone is allowed 200 locks, it'll likely be lowered to 100.

Spells disabled in spawn

Probably long overdue, this should prevent people from torturing each other in spawn. And from kidnapping guards.

Mob Arena boss changes

In a couple of days, I'll be tweaking the Mob Arena around some more, the biggest addition will be potion effects to bosses, meaning that they won't be *as* boring as they currently are. No specifics on this yet, check back later.

Skills cap raised; lots of tweaks

Another change I'll be making in the near future is raising the skills cap, as well as tweaking how Skills experience works and the minimum levels for abilities. I'll also be doing various other changes.

GUI for commands

Something that I'm working on is a simple inventory-based GUI for commands. Nothing too major, but it should allow you to forget a few commands.

Spell tweaks

Eventually, I'll be redoing most spells as far as cost and cooldowns go. Right now everything has a rather high cost and CD, which I made to prevent any abuse. Now that we've broken the system in, I think I can allow you to have a little more fun with it.

Polishing of Quests and Titles

Quests will be refined a bit more, to make them easier for people to understand without having to visit the wiki, and overall being a more fun experience to do. Titles don't save/load properly and I'm looking into possible solutions.

And a bunch of miscellaneous changes that I don't care to list.

As for the future...

Overall, I feel that The Storm is in a fairly good position. I still have a lot of work to do in order to create the experience that I want, however nothing comes without hard work and time. I have a few ideas on how to improve the server, many of which I work on when I have the chance. I won't stop working on the server anytime soon, however recently we haven't had any 'huge' additions, we will soon, right when I get the chance to polish a few things I've been trying to figure out recently.

Hey everyone!

I've been working on a bunch of changes to quests and spells, along with a few other things. Firstly, all quests have been tweaked a bit, the text, costs, rewards, etc. which I hope will make the quests a more enjoyable and worthwhile experience.

Most quests have had the number of items requested lowered, and the reward to be slightly more. Perks have also had their costs adjusted, with shopkeeper being lowered and engineer being heightened.

Another smaller change is that fireworks will now be fired when taking a completing a quest! Not a huge change but it's a small addition to add to the experience.

We are also introducing a new type of quest -- Skills quests!

Skills quests are a series of tasks related to a certain skill (Such as mining, sword fighting, etc.) that will give you a special prefix upon completion, along with extra levels you couldn't obtain otherwise, along with a title! They will only be able to be taken by those who have reached level 500 in the skill. Currently they haven't been added quite yet, but they will be soon.

Spells have also had some major changes done. Mostly a lot of tweaking with the cooldowns and costs. Most spells are much cheaper to cost, and have a significantly shorter cooldown. This should help make spells more viable in combat. Spells will soon be enabled in the Mob Arena as well.

We still plan to make more changes to spells soon, mostly reducing the cost/cooldowns even further, but also tweaking and adding more in the future.

posts.message:
I've mostly finished the warp plugin, and it's functional now.

Any tier 3 shopkeeper can set a warp up to their shop at spawn. The setup process is fairly simple.

Firstly, you need to name your shop. It can be anything you want, however be sure it doesn't break any rules. You can do this with /shopsetname <shopname>

Afterwards, you need to set up the warp. Stand/look where you want it to be, and use /shopsetlocation

Thats it!

Anyone can now warp to your shop using /shopwarp <username>

You can check if someone has a shop with /shopcheck <username>

And you can list all shops with /shoplist

Just a few notes regarding warps.

All warps must be within the spawn area.

All warps must be set to/near your shop. They shouldn't be in any other part of spawn that isn't near a plot of yours.

Warps are free if you are in spawn, but cost 50 crystals if you are outside of spawn.

Shops may reset when I perform updates on the code, but you only need to set your shop location and name again for it to work.

Also, a new ability that was added today for shopkeepers.

If you own a plot, you're now given greater control over it. You can modify various things from if others can use levers, to if ice melts in your plot. This should help to create better shops overall. It'll go live tonight, and will be documented later on.

Quick tutorial on using it

/region flag <yourname> <flag name> <value>

Shopkeeper 1 flags: use, interact, chest-access

Shopkeeper 2 flags: greeting, farewell

Shopkeeper 3 flags: lava-fire, snow-fall, snow-melt, ice-form, ice-melt, mushroom-growth, leaf-decay, grass-growth, vine-growth, soil-dry, lava-flow, water-flow

Value should be allow or deny for everything except greeting/farewell

Hey all!

Just introducing a few features I've added in the past couples of days (weeks?) I'm still planning to add a ton more, and with spawn being updated, we'll soon have a ton of space for new storylines for quests! Along with this, we'll be opening up a few new server shops in those buildings, and we'll work on adding some NPCs to populate those areas as well. We're going to be adding a lot of new buildings soon, and we're finishing up the last renovations of the old ones.

Now, onto the features.

Horse Storing

This is kinda hard to explain, so I'll give an example

Let's say I found this sweet horse. His name is Rick.

I'm outside of spawn, and want to take him to my house on the edge of the map. Normally, I'd have to walk him 5000+ blocks, but now, I don't have to!

Just take off his saddle, and he'll be saved in it

Right-click the ground with the saddle, and he's back!

Storm Shards

Storm shards are found when killing mobs and breaking blocks. They are somewhat rare, and are used to upgrade your items, similar to enchantments. However, they stack with enchantments, and add a percent-based extra damage to your item. You can upgrade it up to 10 times, however the item has a chance of breaking when upgrading.

threads.title: New NPCs, Shops, Quests, and more!

posts.author: RiotShielder
posts.message:
Hey everyone!

This post will review a few changes we've seen in the last week or two, along with showing off a few things we will be adding in the future.

NPCs

In the past few weeks you've likely noticed that all the NPCs were removed, and then re added about a week ago. This was to work on getting NPCs into a more interactive state, which I feel was successfully done. NPCs will now show text in chat as well as talk, and if you are using the server resource pack, when you right-click a NPC, they'll talk to you!



It's nothing major, but they're cool features that make the server a little more unique than the rest.

Shops

This is one of the biggest changes we've made in the last few weeks. We've redone the NPC shops system so that they no longer use a format similar to player shops. Instead, they use a inventory-based menu to display items for sale, and you are now able to sell items to NPCs.

The prices are extremely bad, so we don't recommend actually buying/selling anything with them, however they do provide a cap on the market, so that player shops cannot over charge for items, or under pay you for your items. This was done in part to mlyns post about improving the economy, and hopefully this will prevent any one item from becoming too expensive or cheap.



Quests

A month or so ago, I had made an announcement regarding a new questing system. I was ready to implement it, however we ran into trouble with creating quests. Overall, the cons outweighed the benefits so we scrapped it and shifted our focus onto improving the old system. This led to me removing the old quests, and completely redoing and tweaking them, so that they provide a more fair reward.

It also allowed me to redo the way perk trainers work, instead of the old 3 for each tier of every perk, you now can get all of them from one trainer.





We plan on adding more quests in the near future, until all of the old ones are added back. After they return, we'll try to get new quests out on a regular basis, and creating all the quests posted in the suggestions forum

Mob Arena

Not a whole lot to say here. Items have been re added to the arena, but much more thought was put into what items were put in, and how many. You'll have to use your materials smartly.

Banks

In the near(ish) future, we'll be rolling out something new, banks! We will still need a bank building for this (Our builder has taken a break for an undefined amount of time), but as soon as we get one up, you can expect banker NPCs to be storing your items for you!



Obviously you could just store your items in a chest or your backpack, so what makes banks any different?

We really don't know, but it has a really cool menu, and tabs!

As always, if you have a suggestion for the server, please post it! We'd love you hear your opinions, also head over to the community voting forum and vote on a few of the topics we have open!

Until next time.

As long as these disputes don't get the point of harassment/childish stupidity, they should benefit the server.

However, it also gets annoying to see these types of arguments in chat, so I came up with a rather simple solution - a new chat channel.

War Chat will be used for any conflicts, disputes, or similar matters. If you are arguing in global chat, you will be asked to take it to War Chat, if you continue, you'll be muted or kicked.

posts.author: RiotShielder
posts.message:
Hello everyone!

We've been growing for the past 6 months, and we're at a point we can actually do something fun as a server! Our first war event is planned for this Friday, and will last until there is a single nation remaining.

This is more of a test run to see how things go, and to see how we can improve wars in the future. We don't want to force anyone who doesn't want to PvP to have to be a part of the war event.

The war is planned to start on Friday, 3-13-15 at 6:00PM, server time.

What is a War Event?

A war event pits all nations against each other, the goal is to capture the most town blocks of other nations. You can capture town blocks by standing on another towns claimed land, a notification will appear in chat saying the coordinates of the town block so that town can defend themselves.

What's the reward for winning?

10000 Crystals! This will be split between all participating towns. The more town blocks you capture, the more crystals you win!

How long will the event last?

The event will last until there is only one nation standing. If the war doesn't end within a few days, I'll manually end it.

What about after the event? Do I lose my town blocks?

No! Captured town blocks will be returned as soon as the event is over. Towns are still protected during the war event

What if I don't want to be part of this event?

Participation is optional. Players who do not want to PvP are not required to take part in the war event.

posts.author: RiotShielder
posts.message:
Hey everyone.

I've been working on a remade version of our Storm Shards plugin, and today we're finally ready to release it!

The system is largely the same, however it was recreated to be more efficient and customizable for the server. I've still got a bit of work to do as far as polishing the plugin, but it's overall done, although I may add more features in the future.

[IMG]/data/storm-history/t466_imgur-VWY7HAi.png[/IMG]

The new shard description

Your old storm shards will no longer work, however you can convert them to the new shards with the command below.

/shardconvert <amount>

Please note your new shards will be dropped at your feet, so be sure you're in a safe place so you don't lose your new shard.

You cannot however convert your old items that were improved with a storm shard, however those items should be able to work with the new system.

[IMG]/data/storm-history/t466_imgur-ncKeClI.png[/IMG]

The new improved item descriptions

The new system is unique from the old one in a few ways. The largest difference is the method in which you apply storm shards to your items. Instead of adding the item you'd like to combine with a shard in an anvil, you need to go to the windmill at spawn and stand on the emerald block inside of the windmill while it is raining, you can then use the command /shard to apply a storm shard in your inventory to a sword, axe, bow, or piece of armor that you are holding. The only other major difference is there are now only 5 levels instead of 10, and there is currently no risk of your item breaking while upgrading.

[IMG]/data/storm-history/t466_imgur-FZwWFYi.png[/IMG]

[IMG]/data/storm-history/t466_imgur-yf6wCKp.png[/IMG]

You can also use the command /shardbonus to see your current damage and defense bonuses.

[IMG]/data/storm-history/t466_imgur-Ti6qwud.png[/IMG]

Please note the values here aren't calculated correctly, the actual bonuses are 4.5% and 3% to weapons/armor respectively.

Hey all!

A few new changes I'd like to announce today, mainly regarding Premium!

As of Thursday, we've changed Premium from a tiered 1-time purchase over to a single-rank subscription format. There were a few reasons for this change, the biggest being that we really couldn't justify having 3 tiers of what was basically the same rank, with only minor differences between each other.

The new Premium ranks were priced fairly, at $7/month, however the longer the term of the premium rank, the cheaper it is per month. We also offer a lifetime premium rank.

All prior premium ranks have been converted to the new one, with a lifetime status. Anyone who had purchased Premium II/III will receive 3000/6000 crystals respectively in compensation to the change.

Along with these changes to the format of the rank, we've also worked on adding a few new abilities to it.

Marks

As announced before, marks will be available to all Premium members, they are purely cosmetic particles that trail behind you as you walk around. They will be available in the coming days.

Premium MA kits

Another addition is premium-exclusive Mob Arena kits, which will focus on providing new ways to play in our arenas, they will be releasing in a future update.

Premium-Only world(s)

We don't have enough details on this to say anything solid, so stay tuned!

Disguises

Lastly, all Premium members have access to four disguises. More disguise options are planned for the future; details will follow when they are ready.

posts.author: RiotShielder
posts.message:
Hey all!

After a good 2-3 months of not too much happening to the server, we're ready to release a much needed update to the server. Much will be changing, hopefully for the better! The majority of our work has been done on a private staff-only server that the rest of you can't connect to, with some plugin debugging done on the test server. We've all been working hard to create a better server for our players, and hope that these changes reflect that.

This post will go over a few of the changes we will be rolling out later this Summer. We don't have a definite date quite yet as it takes time to be sure everything is functioning properly, especially with the scope of what we're planning.

New town plugin

After many problems with the Towny plugin, we've opted to look at some other alternatives out there, as well as looking at restructuring how we handle towns on the server. We've come up with a few ideas, and will be going more in-depth with what we're planning in the future.

New perks system

The system is currently composed of three different perks, we're working to redo much of it, as well as make the perks system better than it currently is. It'll remain similar to how it is now, you can take quests to receive perks at the cost of crystals, however we'll be moving some things around to put an emphasis on allowing players to 'sell' their ability to use a perk to others.

A new world

A new world is part of the planned update alongside the changes to towns and perks. More details will follow as the work progresses; there is no definite release date yet.

posts.author: RiotShielder
posts.message:
This post will be going over some more changes that will be contained in the server update we are planning, I'll be going further into detail with everything as we move along.

Towns

Towns will play a major part in the new server, and town ranks will be more important than they were previously. We're moving to a new plugin that we previously used for a (short) time back in March. It's much more powerful and customizable than Towny ever was. You're no longer constrained to chunks that you must build in, you now can create plots of any size and shape for your town members, and with the changes to our ranking system, you're able to customize many aspects of each plot, and even town regions themselves. Players will be unable to build/destroy outside of a town, except in the mining world, nether, and end.

Towns are broken down into three parts

Towns
This covers everyone who is in the town, and information about the town, such as the name, the mayor, etc. A town on its own doesn't have any land, it must rank up and earn territories for that

Territories
These are large regions of the map that towns are able to claim by ranking up. Territories don't have to be adjacent. All town members can build/destroy in a territory owned by their town. Territories are square, and will be between 200x200 and 500x500 blocks large.

Plots
Plots are smaller areas within a town's territories. They can vary in size and shape, with settings that towns can customize for their members.

posts.author: RiotShielder
posts.message:
Improved chat

Since we've moved to having multiple servers, it's now a bit hard to talk to those who aren't playing on the same server as you, however we're working on a plugin that will allow you to talk between servers in different chat channels similar to how you can now. We'll also be looking into other chat-related features we can add!

Inventory sorting, backpacks, horses, and banks!

So this is a pretty long topic here, but it'll be talking about a few new features you'll be able to use, as well as the bringing over of some old ones. Firstly, we'll be introducing a new way to easily sort your inventory between all nearby chests, meaning you can easily deposit all of your items after a mining trip with a simple command into the chests they should be stored in.

[IMG]/data/storm-history/t638_imgur-h4PueU9.png[/IMG]

We'll also finally be introducing banks, which will allow you to store your items in a safe manner where nobody can touch them other than you. You'll be able to access your vault at spawn.

[IMG]/data/storm-history/t638_imgur-x3mgjiR.png[/IMG]

Along with all of this, we will be keeping backpacks as they are now (3 rows for citizens, 6 rows for premium), as well as storing horses in eggs.

Premium revisited, and server monetization

Obviously servers cost money to run, and while my goal with The Storm is not to make money, it is nice to be able to not have to pay out-of-pocket for hosting, builders, and related expenses.

We've lowered the Premium pricing to $5 for 1 month, $13 for 3 months, $24 for 6 months, and $40 for lifetime. We've also added a 1 week option for $1, one-time only per account. We're looking at adding some more features to premium, such as more creative plots, extra rewards (more on that in a later post), and other things we feel can help improve the experience of premium members without giving them an insane advantage over non-premium players.

[IMG]/data/storm-history/t638_imgur-TMZBXzY.png[/IMG]

We're also planning to add more items that can be purchased in our shop, although we're not ready to give out details at the moment, the navbar more-or-less helps you figure out our ideas.

Once again, our ultimate goal here isn't to make money, and we certainly don't want to create a pay-to-win aspect here, or an over-monetized feel to the server.

Auctions

We're also excited to be bringing back Auction in a much improved format!

[embed https://s9e.github.io/iframe/imgur.min.html#csPUVzU]

Auction creation will be available to Shopkeepers only, however anyone can bid on them.

ETA and other stuff

We're hoping to get everything out on the 31st, although it's not 100% solid due to some last-minute changes. Some of our staff members (@PikachuPals and @dx2tuyen) have been hard at working creating quests for the update, and the rest are lazy and I'll probably fire them.

The next thread will contain info about new stuff we're adding, that's (as far as we know) unique to our server. (Login rewards, storm shard updates, monthly challenges, and moving structures from the creative server to the survival server)

Till next time.

[IMG]/data/storm-history/t638_imgur-x3mgjiR.png[/IMG]

Along with all of this, we will be keeping backpacks as they are now (3 rows for citizens, 6 rows for premium), as well as storing horses in eggs.

Premium revisited, and server monetization

Obviously servers cost money to run, and while my goal with The Storm is not to make money, it is nice to be able to not have to pay out-of-pocket for hosting, builders, and related expenses.

I've been working hard the last few weeks getting everything in line for the server, we're progressing slowly but it should start picking up in a few weeks now that I've finished updating our older plugins.

Just to recap, here's what I've done

Rewrote chat plugin to easily add more multi-server features in the future

Rewrote titles plugin to sync between servers

Rewrote server messages plugin to cover more death messages as well as function better

Created NPC plugin to re-add talking NPCs as well as NPC trading at spawn

This has been my focus for a while, and now that these plugins are up to par, I'll be free to work on making some more in the near future, hopefully getting another 2-3 out in the next month.

We've also updated to a new anti-cheat plugin, as well as upped our x-ray protection, this should help ensure that everyone on our server has a fair playing field no matter their playstyle.

As far as features go, we've added some recently as well!

Eclipses free-for-all PvP arena has been completed and is now open to add, use /pa ffa join in order to play. The kits are still needing to be balanced, and we'll try to get that done soon.

Hey all!

We've been working on another update for the server, which will reintroduce a few old features. This will be releasing in parts over the next week, and we'll be working to add more to the server as time goes on.

Skylands

A new world will be added soon, in which all tier I towns will receive a free 500x500 territory. This world doesn't reset, and uses a new skylands generator to provide a new style of islands. This world will be the only one in which you can harvest storm shards





Storm Shards

If you played before the reset in August, you probably know about storm shards, they are special items that drop occasionally when killing mobs or mining. These items can then be used to enhance your weapons, armor, and tools, allowing them to do more damage, decrease the damage you take, or work faster.

They will be reintroduced and will initially work as they did before, however we do have future plans to improve the plugin as we add in new features. Storm shards will only drop in the skylands, and can upgrade and weapon, armor, or tool up to 5 times, giving you up to a 50% damage increase on a sword/tool/bow, or a total 23% PvP/PvE damage reduction on a full set of armor.

Stargates

A staple of the Mechanic perk, Stargates will be reintroduced as the main method of transportation between towns, worlds, and spawn. In the near future, TP cooldowns will be increased, and the town spawn command will be removed

New Horse Plugin

I recently created a new version of the horse storing plugin from scratch, which will allow us to store all horse data, such as speed and jump strength. This means when you store your horses in a saddle, they won't become slower or jump lower, they will be an exact copy from before!

This plugin is already live, and due to this all of your old saddles can't be used to spawn the horses, they can however will be used as saddles to tame new horses.

New staff rank, and new trial mod

We added a tester staff rank recently, with the goal of better balancing the server as well as testing out new features before they go live on the survival server. We're also introducing a new trial mod as of today, @CookieMage107, our testers as of now are @Grijzejager3 and @WinterSolstice8

We're also going to be getting scratch cards and banks available as soon as possible, and we're working on re enabling NPC shops as well. We have more plugins being worked on to introduce even more new features, and hope to have a few more out in November.

If you have any suggestions, as always, feel free to reply to this thread or post in the suggestions subforum.

posts.author: RiotShielder

Hey all!

We're still working on adding new features to the server, as well as improving old ones. I've been working on a custom town plugin for our server for around a month now, and it's approaching the point to where we can start using it on the live server. Currently it cannot be used to claim land (This will be added soon), however you can create towns, nations, invite players to them, etc.

You can test this plugin now by going to /server test, /town help will get you started. We ask that you report any bugs or suggestions under feedback on the forums.

We have a lot planned for this plugin, and it allows us to have some special integration with the rest of our custom plugins such as

- Chat channels automatically created for towns/nations

- Special titles for town/nation owners, maybe even town members

- Town/nation specific storm shard improvements

This new plugin will be going live hopefully by the end of the month, however the old one will remain until land claiming is completed and thoroughly tested.

With this new plugin, we will also be making a few changes to how land is managed. Currently we use a cuboid plot system, allowing great flexibility at the cost of simplicity, which is nice however it marks a huge barrier to new players. We will be going to a chunk based system similar to Towny.

Along with this, we will be allowing breaking throughout the entire main world to help new players get started with less confusion, however we strongly encourage you to gather in the mining world so the main world stays pristine for as long as possible.

We have a lot planned for the server, and we are slowly getting there. Every new plugin created allows us to have new possibilities for the future, as well as a much greater amount of customization.
